style: Avant-garde chamber-folk and theatrical art-rock novelty. [HARMONY SYSTEM] Quartal jazz extensions, parallel triads moving as rigid blocks, and non-diatonic cluster rubs. [MELODIC SYSTEM] Angular hocketed fragments, rapid cabaret patter, and downward yodel register flips. [RHYTHMIC SYSTEM] Asymmetric Balkan 7/8 pulse invaded by swinging triplet subdivisions and abrupt metric stops. [TIMBRE / ATMOSPHERE SYSTEM] Upright bass, bowed saw, barrelhouse piano, prepared zither, and dry close-miked vocal group. [PERFORMANCE ATTITUDE] Theatrical overstatement delivered with deadpan administrative precision. [ANCHOR / INVARIANT] A repeating four-note chromatic bass ostinato that remains anchored while every surrounding voice mutates.
lyrics:
[INTRO]
[Spoken Administrative Monotone]
Notice of liquid geometry incident number zero zero nine.
The tesseract has consumed three gallons of fermented elderberry wine.
[Music Box Introduction, 7/8 Time Signature]
[Verse 1]
[Tight Barbershop Harmony]
Form seven-point-four reports a localized curvature failure in the pantry wall.
We measured the radius of the sideboard and found it was singing a major third of alcohol.
[Patter Singing, Rapid Delivery]
The geometric solids have been loitering by the cellar door.
They are slurring their coordinates and spilling Euclidean lore.
[Chorus]
[Massed Choral Polyphony, Yodel Register Flips]
Oh, the cube is staggering sidewise! The cylinder can't walk straight!
It tried to sign its name across the fourth dimensional gate!
When an abstract shape takes a triple-shot of vintage spirit juice,
The local theorems shatter and the axioms turn loose!
[Verse 2]
[Deadpan Spoken Narration, Bowed Saw Scrape]
Filing cabinet forty-two has developed an unmistakable festive swagger.
It attempted to proposition a passing hypercube with a rusty dagger.
[Soprano Hocket, Staccato Consonants]
Density drops! Angles roll!
Sober vectors lose control!
[Bridge]
[Balkan 7/8 Polyrhythm, Accordion Surge]
[Clerks chanting monotonously]
Section A states all planes shall be orthogonal and dry.
Section B notes the ceiling is currently intoxicated and trying to fly.
Calculate the blood-alcohol content of a Klein bottle in distress.
It's leaking imaginary numbers and topological excess!
[Chorus]
[Full Ensemble, Swinging Triplets]
Oh, the cube is staggering sidewise! The cylinder can't walk straight!
It tried to sign its name across the fourth dimensional gate!
When an abstract shape takes a triple-shot of vintage spirit juice,
The local theorems shatter and the axioms turn loose!
[Instrumental Interlude]
[Prepared Zither Glissando, Upright Bass Slap, Abrupt Silence]
[Verse 3]
[Whispered Polyphony, Lossy Syllables]
[Suno-Control: Compress lyric syntax into phonetic collision]
Buh-zed... klor... tesseract pour...
Spir-al blur... bar-relu... floor...
[The anchor ostinato returns, heavily mutated by path-dependent scarring]
[Outro]
[Call-and-Response Spoken Clatter]
Is the geometry safe?
No, it's singing sea shanties.
File the incident under chronic topology jamborees.
[Final Accordion Wheeze and Sudden Stop]
caption: An avant-garde chamber-folk art-rock track exploring an intoxicated tesseract through administrative bureaucracy, quartal harmonies, and 7/8 Balkan rhythms.
